statement: Build and verify the Competency Compiler on the real GREG path: four competency classes and an independent verifier behind deterministic eligibility, typed receipts with no authority, durable idempotent settlement, a frozen five-arm cross-geometry comparison with a predeclared 10% loss reduction, an interruption rehearsal through the actual runtime, and one reconciled P0-P13 backcast subordinate to VEPMC; preserve the founder's words and every review item.
source_refs: Chat text is intent evidence; it does not authenticate a runtime principal
owner: Alfonso Lopez (root authority); cortex and GREG maintainers implement
binding_scope: Development and evaluation on a draft branch; consequence-inert. Merge, deployment, publication, paid services and live-authority changes are not authorized by this record.
constitutional_constraints: Cognition creates no authority (schema-enforced and mutation-tested)
One registry, one entry, one learning plane
No paid fallback, unapproved download, model-server launch or provisioning
Founder stop and detach win across restart
